items.title: Everest Group (EG) Could Be 7% Undervalued As Softer Q2 Results Test Sentiment
items.summary: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) has drawn fresh attention after reporting softer Q2 results, with revenue of US$3.96b that declined 11.8% year on year and missed analyst expectations, and the stock slipping 3.9% after the release. At around US$378 per share, Everest Group has given investors a 90 day share price return of 18.4% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 10.57%.
